recognize_zh: 四格骨髓抹片分別看到核分離的巨核細胞、核出芽（nuclear budding）的紅血球母細胞、帶毒性顆粒的顆粒球與芽細胞，卻幾乎看不到 VEXAS 經典的前驅細胞空泡，符合以 MDS 表現為主的 UBA1 S56F 亞型。
features: Panel A: megakaryocyte with widely separated, non-lobated nuclei (dysmegakaryopoiesis)
Panel B: erythroid precursor with nuclear budding/irregular nuclear lobation (arrow)
Panel C: granulocyte with coarse toxic-type granules adjacent to a densely granulated precursor
Panel D: blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm (arrows)
Pertinent negative: no conspicuous cytoplasmic vacuoles in myeloid or erythroid precursors
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show trilineage dysplastic and reactive changes. Megakaryocytes include forms with widely separated nuclei, and erythroid precursors show nuclear budding. Granulocytes contain coarse toxic granules, and scattered blasts with fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm are present. Notably, prominent cytoplasmic vacuolization of myeloid and erythroid precursors is not seen. In conjunction with 5% blasts and a UBA1 S56F mutation, findings are consistent with VEXAS syndrome presenting as myelodysplastic neoplasm with increased blasts, with minimal vacuolization characteristic of the S56F subtype.

ddx.vs: Classic VEXAS shows prominent punched-out vacuoles in myeloid and erythroid precursors, which are largely absent here; the specific UBA1 variant is confirmed by sequencing.

ddx.dx: MDS with increased blasts without UBA1 mutation
ddx.vs: Dysplasia and blast count can be identical, so separation requires UBA1 sequencing and the autoinflammatory clinical picture.
Megaloblastic change shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open chromatin and giant metamyelocytes without increased blasts, and corrects with B12/folate.
These show precursor vacuolization and ring sideroblasts without clonal blast increase, and are identified by copper/zinc levels and exposure history.
